psychological_meaning: Kenyan Copper evokes feelings of warmth, earthiness, and sophistication. Its rich, reddish-brown hue suggests stability, reliability, and a connection to nature. This color can also inspire a sense of comfort and nostalgia, reminiscent of aged materials and traditional craftsmanship. It's a grounding color that promotes feelings of security and well-being.
